ideas.pitch: A clinical-grade AI health platform featuring remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) heart rate sensing via webcam, multi-language triage, and secure medical data management tailored for rural clinics.
ideas.title: MediTriage Multi-Language & rPPG
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets effective use of AI and practical feasibility by utilizing proven open-source computer vision for vitals, fitting the healthcare focus of Hacknexus.

ideas.pitch: An AI training platform for medical students where users can interview an AI patient scored on a 6-dimension rubric and practice clinical assessments.
ideas.title: Clinical-Simulator AI Patient
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges value educational and clinical impact, and a working interactive LLM simulation is highly engaging during a live demo presentation.

ideas.pitch: A 60-second voice analysis web tool that screens for early vocal biomarkers associated with Parkinson's Disease.
ideas.title: VoiceDx Parkinson's Screen
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates rapid medical diagnostic capability with a concrete, quantifiable output, matching the innovation and relevance criteria.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent AI system that audits insurance prior authorization decisions in healthcare for algorithmic bias and justification fairness.
ideas.title: ClaimBias AI Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses real-world healthcare administrative pain points with advanced agentic workflows that stand out to technical juries.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered trust and acquisition engine tailored for specialized dental and prosthodontic clinics to convert patient inquiries into booked procedures.
ideas.title: Prosthodontic Patient Acquisition Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines healthcare vertical depth with commercial viability, appealing directly to the practical feasibility and potential impact criteria.
